paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Australia
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of counts of vaccine-related sentiments in Australia, categorized by their polarity scores. The x-axis, labeled "Polarity scores," spans from -1.0 to 0.6 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Counts," ranges from 0 to 140,000 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. A single blue line, marked with blue circular data points and connected by solid lines, represents the data. The line remains near zero for polarity scores from -1.0 to approximately -0.6, then rises to a peak of 135,000 at a polarity score of 0.0, before declining to approximately 55,000 at a polarity score of 0.1, rising again to about 70,000 at 0.2, then falling to around 25,000 at 0.4, and finally to zero at 0.6.
